how_tos.How to redeem reward points of IRCTC SBI:
Step 1: Login into IRCTC, using the registered username and password linked to your railway number.
Step 2: Choose the reward points option to pay for your new railway ticket at the payment gateway.
Step 3: Reward points redemption can only be done on confirmed railway tickets booked for AC 1st Class, Executive Chair Car, AC 2 Tier, AC 3 Tier, and AC Chair Car.
Note: Reward points can also be referred to as IR points.

reward_point_benefits:
* The reward points can be only redeemed against the total ticket fare; service charge charged by IRCTC included.
* For individual passengers, the cardholder cannot redeem reward points.
* For more than one passenger fare or to redeem points equivalent to ticket fare, part payment cannot be made for such transactions.
* In case you fall short of reward points, you can purchase them at Rs.125 (reward point value).
* If you cancel the redeemed ticket, only reward points would be credited back to your SBI Reward Points, SBI Travel Reward Points, and Purchase Points and not cash.
miscellaneous: Flexipay is an option provided by SBI wherein you convert your spending into monthly equated installments (EMI). Any transaction over Rs.2,500 can be converted into EMI within 30 days of the spend.

faqs.What is the SBI IRCTC Platinum Credit Ca: The 11-digit number that is printed below the cardholder's name on the SBI IRCTC Platinum Credit Card is the loyalty number.
faqs.For how long are reward points valid?: The reward points will lapse after a period of three years from the date of membership registration.
faqs.What if I lose my credit card and how wi: The IRCTC SBI Platinum credit card comes with a reward point expiry policy. In case of loss of the card, you can always request for a replacement. The renewal fee is dependent on your credit score.
faqs.Will I get reward points for tickets boo: No, you will not get SBI reward points for tickets booked through mobile application.
faqs.Can I transfer my SBI reward points earn: No, these reward points cannot be transferred or considered or combined with points earned on any other SBI Card.
faqs.Is it possible to redeem reward points f: Yes, it is possible to redeem your reward points for cash. For this, you can contact SBI credit card customer care.
faqs.What is Flexipay?: Flexipay is an option provided by SBI wherein you convert your spending into monthly equated installments (EMI). Any transaction over Rs.2,500 can be converted into EMI within 30 days of the spend.
faqs.Can I add an add-on card holder for Flex: No, only a primary card holder can opt for Flexipay.
